note: Chinese classical objects for hanfu poses: things a figure holds, carries or sets beside them. Every painted surface carries flowers, landscape or plain colour only: no characters, calligraphy, seals or inscription bands (Chinese objects attract them, so each desc says so). No incense, no religious objects, nothing Japanese (no wagasa or uchiwa outline) or Korean. Furniture lives in FN; hairpins, crowns and pouches in the costume library (AC).
